integrity: All equilibrium and stability claims were reconstructed from the displayed vector field. The baseline index count is backed by an exact-rational checker using rigorous elementary bounds on \(\log 17\).
scientific_limitations: The result does not determine hidden-versus-self-excited basin geometry.
It does not establish global boundedness or validate the paper’s numerical Lyapunov or DSP calculations.
The divergence correction shows that the source’s pointwise argument is insufficient; it does not prove a positive long-time average divergence.
title: Exact equilibrium indices and divergence correction for the Wang–Feng–Chen flow
